notes:
PASS on the fake backend; gate.digest is the digest line printed by the last gate run. Served device mhs://localhost/robosuite-aloha, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0 (the card's floor and the floors of cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1). The card's models[0], robosuite_models/assets/robots/aloha/robot.xml, is read in place from the pinned clone (never copied, imported, installed or modified). The MJCF is the bare Aloha body: 12 hinge joints, six per arm (right at 92-116, left at 139-164), and 12 motor actuators with ctrlranges waist -5..5, shoulder -50..50, elbow -50..50, forearm_roll -5..5, wrist_angle -1..1 and wrist_rotate -1..1, repeated for the left arm (188-201). The bridge derives action.ctrl per actuator from those ctrlranges; the package declares no Limit of its own. The model sets no option timestep (lines 2-4 are an XML comment), so the fake's stand-in library default is published as timestep_ms (a placeholder, not a model bound). The Aloha wrapper attaches the AlohaGripper separately (aloha_robot.py:26-35); robot.xml has no active finger defaults (34-43), so the served model has no gripper. The fake backend is fake.py, a callable stand-in mujoco module that parses the same MJCF for the dimensions, ctrlranges and step and integrates a placeholder first-order motion; it is not MuJoCo and computes no meshes, contacts, equality constraints, inertias or actuator dynamics. MuJoCo itself was not installed and was never run. Expected simulator-family warnings: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the backend is the package's stand-in for the mujoco library, so there is no fake class surface to record or compare) and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the family-derived ticks, action.ctrl[*] and reset seed. G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings. NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo engine; the other nine MJCF robot models in the clone and the other four entries of the card's models list; the robosuite composition (bases, grippers, controllers); rendering, cameras and sensors; snapshot/restore beyond the stand-in's own deterministic state (the bridge advertises snapshot_restore true from the stand-in, but it was not compared with the engine); and any physical Aloha hardware (no hardware run is claimed). Upstream setup.py:17 requires mujoco>=3.2.0 and robosuite>=1.5.0; the gate and fake need neither. The package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is the model/run id and reviewed_by is null.
